Bundle & SAVE!


Restore Youthful Looking Eyes

Bundle your Cosmetic Upper Eyelid Surgery with Sofwave Brow or 3DMIRACL Treatment for just $500!*

Correcting drooping eyelids is one of our specialties at AestheticEye Oculoplastic Surgeons. This procedure, also known as blepharoplasty, can significantly provide a more youthful and alert appearance.

Blepharoplasty, when paired with one of our skin treatments, can really enhance the natural looking results you desire. So for a limited time, we are offering a Bundle & Save Special! Bundle a Cosmetic Upper Eyelid Surgery with a Sofwave Brow or 3DMIRACL® Treatment for just $500!*

Sofwave is an advanced, non-invasive skin tightening treatment that uses innovative ultrasound technology to stimulate collagen and rejuvenate your skin. It adds a more youthful result when bundled with a cosmetic upper eyelid surgery to further lift and smooth horizontal lines and drooping upper lids.

3DMIRACL leverages innovative UltraClear® laser technology to enhance texture, brightness, and overall complexion. This specialized treatment compliments a cosmetic upper eyelid surgery by smoothing fine lines and improving tone and texture.

Call (937) 907-9009 or fill out the form to schedule and claim your savings!

Claim Your Savings

*Cannot be combined with other offers. Savings of $700 off Sofwave Brow or $300 off 3DMIRACL when bundled with a cosmetic upper eyelid surgery only.
